nodes.label: Phase 1: Clean-Device Footprint & First Launch — Context
Phase Boundary (five clean-device defects)
nodes.rationale: Close five clean-device defects found 2026-07-30: oversized package, ~2min invisible launch, no duplicate-instance protection, no setup checklist on healthy first run, blank taskbar icon. Smallest verified changes; preserve user data, processing, beta-6 updater, AD-19/AD-18 contracts.

nodes.label: Measured Baseline (841 MB zip / 1.9 GB installed)
nodes.rationale: Sizes measured directly from built output replacing estimates; superseded in part by execution-time measurement (884.7 MB zip, 1.92 GB installed).

nodes.label: Release-Workflow Updater Regression
nodes.rationale: a6164b1 replaced installer publication with six signed runtime assets; current release.yml publishes none of the three assets expected_asset_names() requires, so select_asset fails => 'update available but assets unavailable'. D-22 resolves inside this phase.

nodes.label: D-01: Size-Cut Scope
nodes.rationale: dedupe ggml-base.en.bin to one location, remove translations/, qml/, Quick/Quick3D DLLs, Qt6Pdf.dll — each provably unused. ~148 MB + ~101 MB.

nodes.label: D-02: Keep opengl32sw.dll
nodes.rationale: Software GL fallback keeps app working on VMs/old GPUs — the exact clean-device population served.

nodes.label: D-03: Qt Allowlist Rejected
nodes.rationale: Aggressive Qt allowlist rejected; a missing module surfaces only in packaged build on clean machine, slowest env to iterate. Revisit only if D-01 insufficient.

nodes.label: D-04: resources/ Not Pre-Approved
nodes.rationale: 102 MB resources/ not pre-approved; investigate what loads before removing; report rather than guess.

nodes.label: D-05: Model Dedupe Resolution Logic
nodes.rationale: Resolution logic is the deliverable, not the deletion; guided demo + admission smoke must both resolve surviving model copy.

nodes.label: D-06: Startup Root Cause
nodes.rationale: RuntimeBootstrapService.assess() called synchronously on UI thread in Backend.__init__ before window shown; full path runs 3 subprocess probes bounded at 30s each ~ worst case 90s with nothing on screen.

nodes.label: D-07: One-Time Startup Cost
nodes.rationale: _requires_full() sends subsequent launches down light path; cold vs warm launches differ sharply, both measured separately.

nodes.label: D-08: Fix Both Startup Sides
nodes.rationale: Show window first with honest per-component progress AND reduce validation cost without weakening admission evidence.

nodes.label: D-09: Honest Progress Copy
nodes.rationale: Progress must name real work (e.g. 'Checking Whisper runtime…'), not generic bar — distinction between honest feedback and ruled-out splash screen.

nodes.label: D-10: Preserve Admission Contract
nodes.rationale: Parallelize the three independent probes permitted; replacing real transcription with weaker liveness check is NOT permitted (evidence AD-18 and Phase 1 runtime contract rest on it).

nodes.label: D-11: Setup Gate is a Failure Gate
nodes.rationale: Existing gate renders only when assessment not-HEALTHY; owner report is request for new behavior (always-on fresh checklist), not a bug fix.

nodes.label: D-12: Always Show Checklist on First Launch
nodes.rationale: On first-ever launch checklist always appears (Ready/Needs Attention per requirement), then Continue leads to demo offer; failure-gate unchanged.

nodes.label: D-13: Checklist Five Verification Items
nodes.rationale: Only: supported Windows version; bundled FFmpeg/ffprobe; bundled Whisper executable + required DLLs; bundled model; writable data directory. Nothing else.

nodes.label: D-14: Never Download/Reinstall Bundled
nodes.rationale: Checklist never downloads/reinstalls a bundled component; remediation stays existing consented signed-repair path.

nodes.label: D-15: Checklist Lives in WebEngine UI
nodes.rationale: Lives in existing WebEngine UI #runtime-setup-overlay reusing app vocabulary; native Qt pre-window rejected — would introduce second visual language for first-impression.

nodes.label: D-16: Setup Acknowledged in config.json
nodes.rationale: 'Setup acknowledged' persists alongside runtime_health in <data_dir>/config.json, not localStorage (guided-tour flag dies with WebEngine profile).

nodes.label: D-17: Demo Offered Only After Checklist
nodes.rationale: Demo offered only after user continues past checklist or deliberately skips; existing demo isolation guarantees (DEMO-04/05) untouched.

nodes.label: D-18: Raise-and-Focus Second Launch
nodes.rationale: Second launch raises and focuses existing window rather than silent exit — silent exit indistinguishable from failed launch.

nodes.label: D-19: Guard Before assess()
nodes.rationale: Guard runs before RuntimeBootstrapService.assess(); a guard after it would leave a second process invisible up to 90s.

nodes.label: D-20: Blank Taskbar Icon Candidates
nodes.rationale: Two candidates: (a) no SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID call => Windows may not associate window with exe; (b) setWindowIcon guarded by os.path.exists with no else. (a) stronger suspect; confirm on packaged build.

nodes.label: D-21: Missing-Icon Not Silent
nodes.rationale: Missing-icon path must stop failing silently regardless of cause.

nodes.label: D-22: Updater Regression Resolved In-Phase
nodes.rationale: release.yml restores publication of Setup.exe/Portable.zip/SHA256SUMS.txt additively; six signed runtime assets stay unchanged; test asserts all three names (owner decision 2026-07-30).

nodes.label: D-23: ISCC Path Normalization
nodes.rationale: build.py must hand ISCC normalized path; raw ..\dist path pushes torch licence files past Windows 260-char MAX_PATH, aborting and producing no Setup.exe. Fixes every checkout depth.

nodes.label: D-24: Undeclared torch/transformers Excludes
nodes.rationale: torch (360.8MB)+transformers(36.4MB) packaged though unimported; add explicit excludes, build from fresh venv from locked requirements, guard with packaged smoke + one real transcription, stop-and-report if requested at runtime.

nodes.label: Deferred Ideas (Qt allowlist, resources/, beta-6 Phase 5 re-verify, FUTR-01..04)
Phase 1 Pattern Map
nodes.rationale: 10 files all extend pre-existing neighboring patterns; no new architecture introduced.

nodes.label: 01-EVIDENCE.md Evidence File
nodes.rationale: One heading per ROADMAP approval/evidence-gate item; NOT YET MEASURED markers are blocking gaps; no averaging, no stale numbers, no missing machine identity.

nodes.label: Size Reconciliation (open ~455MB question)
nodes.rationale: Owner ~800MB/~900MB vs measured; neither closes under MiB/MB; torch+transformers+dup-model explains ~40% of installed gap, ~455MB remains explicitly open.

nodes.label: BUG-27: Post-cut build could not start
nodes.rationale: A build that pruned Qt6Qml.dll/Qt6Quick.dll could not start at all; authoritative post-cut figures superseded by corrected section.

nodes.label: D-20 Taskbar Icon Diagnosis (2026-07-31)
nodes.rationale: Candidate (b) ruled out on installed build via Win32 icon handles; (a) missing AUMID only remaining explanation but symptom did not reproduce.

nodes.label: D-04 resources/ Investigation (106.3MB, 80.9MB .debug.*)
nodes.rationale: resources/ measured, keep-not-cut recommendation; deletion deferred.

nodes.label: resources/ Keep-Not-Cut Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Every .debug.* has release sibling, release-only Qt build; but RESEARCH Assumption A2 unresolved and no packaged WebEngine-render backstop. Keep this phase.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Discussion Log
nodes.rationale: Human reference only; course corrections (wrong branch, wrong framing) and Q1-Q6 answers; not consumed by downstream agents.

nodes.label: ISCC MAX_PATH normalization fix (commit 1b6059d)
nodes.rationale: build.py hands ISCC normalized /DSourceDir /DOutputDir paths; 13 extra chars pushed torch licence files past 260-char MAX_PATH.

nodes.label: Plan 01-03 Summary (setup flag + checklist service + parallelized probes)
Parallelized RuntimeBootstrapService._validate_full (D-10)
nodes.rationale: Three independent probes run concurrently in ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3), preserving real staged transcription + evidence fields; measured ~3x wall-clock reduction.

nodes.label: Plan 01-04: Packaging Size Cuts (Qt prune, model dedupe, excludes)
Backend.__init__ deferred assess() to worker thread (D-06/08)
Plan 01-07 Summary (RuntimeSetupGateModel extension, routing, demo gate)
Physical Evidence Gate (single instance + icon PASS, 4 gaps open)
nodes.rationale: One fresh artifact from 79225df; Setup 379.8MB (-44.7%), expanded 1.10GB, zip 499.8MB (-43.5%); no clean machine; time-to-ready never measured; ~455MB size gap open.
